about: Colchester Subdivision B is a county subdivision in Colchester County, Nova Scotia, covering rural and semi-rural communities rather than a single incorporated town. Settlements, farms, and highway corridors share the Cobequid and central Nova Scotia landscape with neighbouring towns such as Truro, which are counted separately. About 20,000 people live in Colchester Subd. B.
